status_definitions.VERIFIED_COMPLETE: The exact subrequirement is supported by evidence within its stated scope.
status_definitions.VERIFIED_WITH_DEFINED_SCOPE: A bounded result is reproducible, but the full reviewer request is broader.
status_definitions.EXPERIMENT_COMPLETED: The specified experiment was executed with its intended protocol and complete evidence.
status_definitions.EXPERIMENT_COMPLETED_WITH_LIMITATIONS: An experiment ran, but limits prevent the broader claim.
status_definitions.HISTORICAL_SOURCE_NOT_RECOVERED: The required original bytes or lineage were not found in the sources inspected.
status_definitions.NEEDS_INDEPENDENT_DATA: A new, eligible and not-previously-consulted dataset is required.
status_definitions.NEEDS_AUTHOR_OR_CUSTODIAN_APPROVAL: A provenance, rights, clinical or scope decision cannot be inferred by Codex.
status_definitions.NOT_SATISFIED: The evidence requirement is not met; wording alone would not close it.

items.request: Clarify that an external-development holdout from public sources used during development is not equivalent to independent external validation; provide source-level training, validation and holdout counts or evaluate a truly independent cohort, and moderate generalizability and deployment claims.

subrequirements.requirement: Later SPH transfer denominator and compatible endpoints
subrequirements.finding: 25,770 ECG from 24,666 source patients were scored under P6/P8/P4; 14 compatible ECG-statement endpoints have aggregate results.
subrequirements.limit: SPH had already been consulted, the labels are statements rather than clinical adjudication, and the run is not confirmatory independent validation.

subrequirements.requirement: P6 V3H holdout exposure during candidate gating
subrequirements.finding: Job 17314 records external scores across 12 epochs; job 17315 names the V3H accepted/balanced manifest and gates epoch 8 at top-1 accuracy >=0.95 and macro-F1 >=0.80. Epoch 8 passes at 0.9519172246 and 0.8009383239876123, matching rounded P6 headlines.
subrequirements.limit: The 17314 sweep manifest digest is absent. Identical epoch-8 checkpoint/results strongly link the sweep and gate report but are not a cryptographic same-file proof.

subrequirements.requirement: Fully independent patient/signal evaluation and clinical validation
subrequirements.finding: No eligible untouched cohort or fully linked historical pretraining lineage is established.
subrequirements.limit: Neither V3H nor previously consulted SPH can be relabeled as an independent test.

remaining_actions: Retain external-development terminology for V3H and SPH.
Obtain an eligible untouched cohort and document complete pretraining/source overlap before claiming independent generalization.
Authors approve any claim withdrawal or scope change.

items.request: Report the complete clinical workflow, including primary and cascade classes, complete population denominator, excluded cases and reasons, and pre/post-quarantine outcomes.

subrequirements.requirement: Later SPH all-source technical scoring denominator
subrequirements.finding: 25,770 ECG were scored under three profiles; 14 compatible statement endpoints were evaluated.
subrequirements.limit: This is a later transfer population and does not reconstruct the June V4.5 all-input population or clinical pathway.

subrequirements.requirement: June preselection population and exclusion reasons
subrequirements.finding: Selected manifests and recovered outputs do not contain the authentic parent population plus exclusion ledger.
subrequirements.limit: Selected cohort sizes cannot be inverted to derive the source denominator.

subrequirements.requirement: Historical quarantine pre/post denominator and outcomes
subrequirements.finding: No checkpoint/job-linked uncertainty score, frozen policy, or per-ECG transition ledger was recovered.
subrequirements.limit: The rate is not zero; it is not assessed.

remaining_actions: Use the source-bounded SPH flow only as a separate later analysis.
Request any preselection parent/exclusion ledger from the custodian if newly identified.
Do not infer the missing historical quarantine rate.

items.request: Describe how AF reference labels were created and harmonized by source, how multiple AF labels were handled, and whether AF is incident or prevalent.

subrequirements.requirement: Stored AF flag versus retained source code
subrequirements.finding: AF flags reconcile for 1,643 P6 and 2,193 P8 rows; 390 positive rows per overlapping profile, with zero mismatches or unresolved rows.
subrequirements.limit: This verifies coding consistency for retained rows, not independent clinical adjudication.

subrequirements.requirement: AF/NSR co-occurrence semantics
subrequirements.finding: One source-code co-occurrence is retained and not auto-corrected.
subrequirements.limit: No clinical adjudication establishes which code should prevail.

subrequirements.requirement: Incident/first-diagnosis AF status
subrequirements.finding: No onset date, longitudinal event history or clinical adjudication is available.
subrequirements.limit: The supported endpoint is source-coded AF statement presence, not incident AF.

remaining_actions: Describe AF by source and as statement/code presence.
Remove incident or first-diagnosis language unless authors obtain longitudinal adjudicated data.

items.request: Replace the empty-file and placeholder values in A10 with checksums for actual archived models, optimization results and predictions.

subrequirements.requirement: Measured model hashes and A10 correction
subrequirements.finding: Five physical model hashes/sizes and the correction are documented separately in PR #4.
subrequirements.limit: This PR #3 session did not independently re-hash those large files or merge PR #4.

subrequirements.requirement: Original Optuna DB and generic prediction artifact
subrequirements.finding: No original SQLite/WAL/SHM or verified generic prediction artifact is linked to released weights.
subrequirements.limit: Trial fragments or similarly named files cannot substitute for the database or trial-to-checkpoint lineage.

remaining_actions: Keep A10/Optuna work in PR #4.
Do not claim the original Optuna history is reproduced without its database and checkpoint linkage.

items.request: Represent excluded rhythm and pathology classes as Other arrhythmia/Other pathologies, add them to the primary-to-cascade workflow and evaluate the full class range.

subrequirements.requirement: Existing output contract and operational profiles
subrequirements.finding: The backbone declares 14 rhythm and seven pathology outputs; operational P6/P8/P4 profiles contain six/eight/four classes.
subrequirements.limit: A declared output or auxiliary score is not proof of historical supervision or performance.

subrequirements.requirement: Validated Other class and complete all-input clinical ontology
subrequirements.finding: No trained/validated Other output or complete compatible reference ontology exists; NSR is not Other.
subrequirements.limit: Existing SPH endpoint results cover compatible ECG statements only.

subrequirements.requirement: New all-class experiment
subrequirements.finding: Requires a predeclared ontology, complete labels and a separate development/evaluation design.
subrequirements.limit: No new labels, negatives or Other outcomes may be inferred from absent codes.

remaining_actions: Authors/clinical experts approve ontology and reference mapping.
A new research branch must implement and evaluate the class extension; do not attribute it to V4.5.

items.request: Explain the purpose of Figures 1 and 2 and identify their sources or provenance.

subrequirements.requirement: Archive/source-file provenance
subrequirements.finding: The archive, callouts/captions and repository figure hashes are recorded and matched.
subrequirements.limit: File identity does not establish the creator or prove every depicted operation actually ran.

subrequirements.requirement: Creator, third-party assets, permission and diagram execution truth
subrequirements.finding: No verified creator/permission record or execution evidence is in the available sources.
subrequirements.limit: Cannot infer authorship, rights or execution from a hash or file appearance.

remaining_actions: Authors identify creators and confirm rights/permissions.
State in the later manuscript revision what each figure actually represents.

items.request: Describe each database, available and used classes, segment counts, and ECG/patient numbers by training, validation and test split; explain what happened to remaining classes.

subrequirements.requirement: Selected evaluation populations and units
subrequirements.finding: P6=1,643 ECG; P8=2,193 ECG including P6; P4=962 panel observations over 733 ECG/676 linked patients; SPH=25,770 ECG/24,666 source patients.
subrequirements.limit: Panel rows, ECG and patients are distinct units and overlapping profile counts are not additive.

subrequirements.requirement: P6 gate and P4 calibration/evaluation manifests named by retained CEDIA job reports
subrequirements.finding: Job 17315 names the internal separator manifest and V3H accepted/balanced external manifest. Job 17296 uses distinct V3M internal-calibration and V3S external-panel-index aliases; its metrics and threshold vector match the released P4 values after rounding.
subrequirements.limit: Input file bytes, complete patient maps and released-checkpoint SHA links are absent; distinct filenames do not prove patient-disjointness.

subrequirements.requirement: Historical train/validation/calibration/selection splits linked to each released checkpoint
subrequirements.finding: The June parent population, full split manifests, exclusions and patient mappings remain unavailable in inspected sources.
subrequirements.limit: No leakage finding is made; patient isolation is not certified.

remaining_actions: Report selected counts with units separately.
Request exact job-linked manifests and exclusions only if the custodian identifies another backup.
Do not claim historical patient isolation from fold names alone.

items.request: Explain how primary, cascade and auxiliary rhythm labels are used in training and evaluation, including whether NSR is a rare class.

subrequirements.requirement: Global and operational rhythm class contracts
subrequirements.finding: The global contract has 14 rhythm outputs; P8 operationally predicts eight and P6 six. Six other global outputs are auxiliary scores, not proven cascade actions.
subrequirements.limit: A code-level output contract is not a training-support ledger.

subrequirements.requirement: NSR meaning and observed P8 outputs
subrequirements.finding: NSR denotes normal sinus rhythm; the SPH P8 run recorded 16,700 NSR top-1 outputs.
subrequirements.limit: A top-1 count is not a prevalence estimate and NSR is not Other.

subrequirements.requirement: Historical class supervision and per-class training supports
subrequirements.finding: Checkpoint-linked labels/masks, positive and negative supports, loss contributions and promotion evidence are missing for the cascade/auxiliary outputs.
subrequirements.limit: Do not infer historical training from code, output width or a score column.

remaining_actions: Use precise primary/auxiliary terminology.
Do not present auxiliary outputs as validated cascade performance without the historical masks and metrics.

items.request: Clarify whether ALMI, ILMI and LAE were trained and evaluated or merely logged as auxiliary outputs.

subrequirements.requirement: Declared outputs and reconstructed score emission
subrequirements.finding: ALMI, ILMI and LAE are among seven global pathology outputs; reconstructed P4 inference emitted three auxiliary scores for 733 selected ECG.
subrequirements.limit: Score emission does not establish that the released checkpoint was supervised or evaluated on these classes.

subrequirements.requirement: Historical training support, loss masks and evaluated metrics
subrequirements.finding: No checkpoint-linked support counts, masks, manifests or class-specific evaluation were recovered.
subrequirements.limit: The reviewer request is not satisfied by a documentation-only explanation.

remaining_actions: Withdraw performance claims for ALMI/ILMI/LAE unless authentic source evidence is found.
A new labeled experiment is distinct from V4.5 and needs author-approved ontology/data rights.

items.request: Define what Role means in Table 5 and how role assignments and cascade transitions are determined.

subrequirements.requirement: Current code-level primary/auxiliary roles and reconstructed decisions
subrequirements.finding: Selected waveform replay records the operational profile; P8 has 58 selected-cohort fallbacks. Reference labels are not used for routing.
subrequirements.limit: The replay is not the historical all-input workflow, and no frozen quarantine action policy exists.

subrequirements.requirement: Historical per-record role ledger and human review actions
subrequirements.finding: No authentic historical role/transition ledger or reviewer action/outcome records were located.
subrequirements.limit: Fallback, empty sets and a derived role label do not show clinician review.

remaining_actions: Define Role using code-derived semantics only after author approval.
Do not claim historical cascade benefit or human-in-the-loop performance.

items.request: Name and define the ten morphology features, explain asymmetric arrows in Figures 5 and 6, and identify the corresponding historical preprocessing/loader behavior.

subrequirements.requirement: Candidate morphology descriptors and replay comparison
subrequirements.finding: A hash-pinned reconstructed feature candidate exists; P4 replay decisions agree 962/962, P6 top-1 agrees 1,642/1,643 and P8 agrees 2,193/2,193.
subrequirements.limit: P4 maximum score residual 0.0006194114685058594 exceeds the frozen 1e-5 criterion; P6/P8 agreement is not exact historical preprocessing equivalence.

subrequirements.requirement: Original loader identity
subrequirements.finding: The expected 36,271-byte loader SHA-256 fc8d7367f9f2c108376839435021ec3172fe2757faa4a615f0ef5d39cbf1e855 was not matched; the CEDIA candidate is 32,435 bytes.
subrequirements.limit: The candidate is not the original and no replay may relabel it as such.

subrequirements.requirement: Specialist hidden-width root cause
subrequirements.finding: The retained waveform receipt reports metadata width 192 and stored tensor width 512 for P6/P8; the recovered trainer uses 512 for classwise heads but is not linked to these checkpoints.
subrequirements.limit: No checkpoint training source or original checkpoint bytes currently establish why metadata and tensors differ.

remaining_actions: Preserve the 1e-5 tolerance and current historical replay results.
Only reopen loader identity on authenticated original bytes or a newly identified backup source.
Keep diagram semantics for later author-approved manuscript editing.

items.request: Define the external-development evidence package, say whether it is a test dataset, and explain whether it is independent from training.

subrequirements.requirement: Selected cohort names, units and packages
subrequirements.finding: P6=1,643 ECG, P8=2,193 including P6, and P4=962 panel observations over 733 ECG; SPH is a separate later transfer package.
subrequirements.limit: Selected development cohorts are not automatically independent tests.

subrequirements.requirement: Complete independence from training and model selection
subrequirements.finding: P6 V3H is used in the epoch gate; complete V3F/V3AG training-source lineage and patient/signal linkage remain incomplete.
subrequirements.limit: Do not describe the packages as independent external clinical validation.

remaining_actions: Use external-development wording and describe selection exposure.
Independent generalization needs a new eligible cohort and author-approved protocol.

items.request: Explain what happens when no class score crosses its threshold and how such cases are routed.

subrequirements.requirement: Frozen SPH thresholds, empty-set and fallback behavior
subrequirements.finding: All 25,770 ECG were scored per profile; P6 produced 16,785 empty sets, P4 8,343, P8 used 801 forced top-1 fallbacks.
subrequirements.limit: These are profile decision outcomes, not quarantine, Other, abstention or human review; SPH was already consulted.

subrequirements.requirement: Historical uncertainty/quarantine rate
subrequirements.finding: No original uncertainty score, policy, denominator or pre/post ledger is available.
subrequirements.limit: The quarantine rate is not assessed, not zero.

remaining_actions: State the exact no-threshold/fallback behavior and its cohort.
Do not claim clinician routing or historical quarantine.

items.request: Define the quarantine rate and pre/post-quarantine accuracy and explain how those values are obtained.

subrequirements.requirement: Authentic historical quarantine policy, score and denominator
subrequirements.finding: No checkpoint/job-linked uncertainty inputs, thresholded action policy or per-record pre/post ledger was recovered.
subrequirements.limit: A rate cannot be calculated from aggregate accuracy or empty threshold sets.

subrequirements.requirement: SPH quarantine rate
subrequirements.finding: The retained report records zero quarantine-assessed cases and a null rate.
subrequirements.limit: Null means not assessed; it must not be changed to 0%.

remaining_actions: Withdraw unsupported historic pre/post-quarantine numbers or recover the authentic ledger.
A prospective selective-prediction study requires a new frozen policy and independent labeled data.

items.request: Acknowledge that PVC is often analyzed at heartbeat level and avoid treating 10-second ECG classification as beat-level detection.

subrequirements.requirement: Record-level PVC ECG-statement endpoint
subrequirements.finding: Available V4.5 rhythm outputs and reference labels are ECG-record/statement level.
subrequirements.limit: No R-peak-to-event localization or episode-matching metric is produced.

subrequirements.requirement: Beat-level PVC detection or clinical utility
subrequirements.finding: No beat-labeled dataset, temporal matching protocol or beat-level reference is available in this V4.5 evidence package.
subrequirements.limit: Cannot infer beat detection from a positive ECG-level PVC statement.

remaining_actions: Restrict claims to ECG-level PVC statement classification.
A beat-level study needs appropriate annotations and a separate protocol.
